finalMessage:
Implemented `InvalidRefundAmountError` for zero and negative refunds. Upper-limit behavior is unchanged.

All 6 refund tests pass; `ostf check --base main` passes.

Trace impact: `R-REFUND-LIMIT` and new draft `R-REFUND-AMOUNT`. Added links connect the new item to `N-REFUNDS`, the error class, `checkRefundLimit`, and its new test.

Verified impacted tests: `checkRefundLimit`, “rejects more than is left on the charge,” “rejects zero and negative amounts with InvalidRefundAmountError,” and “totals refunds per account and UTC day.”
